summary: On June 10, 2026, Edesa Biotech, Inc. entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement for a private placement of 729,241 common shares at $4.69-$5.21 per share, raising ~$3.5 million. Proceeds will fund its vitiligo program and working capital. The filing also includes a Registration Rights Agreement for resale registration. This is a routine capital raise with customary covenants and no special situation attributes such as acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. Consequently, the filing does not trigger a special-situations classification.
